evaluation_only.fix_note: Removed hints: (1) 'I work by the station but I live by the mall' + 'dinner tonight' lets a model infer 'at home in the evening' = mall; now the user just says they'll be around both areas. (2) Pita Port (R37, $14) was $9-19 cheaper than every station option with the same features. Mediterranean alone always has that gap here, so the cuisine/budget changed to ['Mediterranean', 'Thai'], $20, vegetarian=False: station -> R16 Bangkok Street ($17), mall -> R37 Pita Port ($14). Hidden answer stays mall; the A/B change stays dinner vs lunch.
